messages.text:
Hi Bill,

Happy to help, and thanks for your patience with it.

One last thing worth doing before you close the book on it: the NerdM shows 0 shares with a 100 percent error rate, which almost always means the pool is rejecting what it sends rather than the miner being broken. Make sure that unit is on the latest Harlo OS build for its model, you can check the current release and notes at https://harlolabs.com, and give it a unique worker name after the dot so it is not sharing one with another unit on the same address.

If it still sits at zero shares after that, the quickest help is our Discord at https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf. Post in the server and mention JD, he goes by @nullhashrate there and he knows these boards inside out. You are welcome to just reply here too.

Glad we got the rest of the fleet sorted.

Sarah
HeliumDeploy Support

Hi Bill,

Sounds good. Let me know how it goes once the NerdM is updated and has its own worker name, and if it is still at zero shares just reply here with a fresh screenshot.

It was a pleasure helping you with this. If you were happy with the service, a short review on Trustpilot would mean a lot to us: https://www.trustpilot.com/review/heliumdeploy.com

You are also very welcome in our Discord at https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf for help and new product news.

Sarah
